'''Marragh the Edge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] warrior fighting for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
